pages.title: Brass Knuckles
pages.text: Brass Knuckles are fast close-range equipment with 250 durability. A successful strike slows the victim's horizontal motion and briefly limits repeated damage. They have their own behavior rather than metal sword powers.
They accept the supported melee and durability enchantments, including Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Unbreaking, and Mending, subject to the normal enchantment rules.
